name: PT Cilacap Samudera Fishing Industry Tbk
summary: PT Cilacap Samudera Fishing Industry Tbk functions as a vertically integrated seafood enterprise within Indonesia. The company manages the entire value chain, from catching and processing fish to freezing, cold storage, and both exporting and importing various marine products. It secures its raw materials through a dual approach: operating its own dedicated fishing vessels and collaborating with local fishermen. Established in 1999, its headquarters are located in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia.
